whatIsIt.eli5: Extra helpers used only while learning, so deep layers don't forget.
whatIsIt.simple: In the YOLOv9 paper, an auxiliary reversible branch gives extra supervision during training and is removed for inference. The Ultralytics YOLOv9 configs shown here do not include this auxiliary branch.
whatIsIt.engineer: Auxiliary reversible branch + multi-level auxiliary information (paper §4.1); training-only; absent from Ultralytics cfg/models/v9.

whyExists.eli5: Deep networks can lose details on the way.
whyExists.simple: It counters the information bottleneck so gradients stay reliable.
whyExists.engineer: Mitigates information bottleneck in deep nets.
